pages.name: Italian Game: Classical Variation, Giuoco Pianissimo
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nbd2-f1-g3 with the rook still on f1 (now after Re1); plan 2 called a4 and Rb1 a minority attack. Both rewritten; British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Classical Variation, Giuoco Pianissimo
pages.notes: Plan 4's 'a6-b5 pawn structure' rewritten as ...b5 and ...Ba7; plan 3 tidied. British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Classical Variation, Giuoco Pianissimo, with a6
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the knight as Nbd2 (it is on d2) via f1 before castling and Re1; the overview's '...a6 prevents Nb5' had no knight able to reach b5; plan 2 named White's moves in a Black plan. Rewritten; British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Classical Variation, Giuoco Pianissimo, with h6
pages.notes: Plan 1's 'Italian maneuver' via f1 came before Re1; rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Classical Variation, Giuoco Pianissimo, with h6
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed via f1 before Re1; plan 3 called a4-a5 a minority attack. Both rewritten; British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Classical Variation, Greco Gambit, Greco Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Re1 'pin the e5 pawn' (there is no e5-pawn); rewritten around Re1+ on the open e-file and Qb3 against f7. Plan 2 tidied around 9...d5.

pages.name: Italian Game: Classical Variation, Greco Gambit, Moeller-Therkatz Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Rxe7 with the e4-knight in the way; rewritten around 11.Rxe4 d6 12.Bg5 Bxg5 13.Nxg5. Plan 2 rewritten with the same line; overview notes the piece must be won back.

pages.name: Italian Game: Scotch Gambit, Max Lange Attack Accepted
pages.notes: Plan 1 used a c4-bishop that is gone (a Black pawn stands on c4); plan 4 suggested ...Kf8 (covered by the g7-pawn). Plans 1, 2 and 4 rewritten around 9...Rg8 10.Bg5 and ...Rxg7.

pages.name: Italian Game: Two Knights Defense
pages.notes: The overview missed that White is a pawn down after 5.d4 Bxd4 6.Nxd4 Nxd4; plans 2 and 3 rewritten (...h6, queen recapture, f4 against f6 and f7).

pages.name: Italian Game: Two Knights Defense
pages.notes: Plan 2 named Ng5 in a Black plan; rewritten as 4.Ng5 d5 5.exd5 Na5. British spelling.
